findings.message: The confirmed no-final-newline first-claim defect cannot be repaired inside T08's frozen touches: story.mjs hashes the original pre-Execution bytes, then appends a newline and rejects the changed contract hash. T08 can add a located preflight diagnostic, but the byte-preserving formatter fix needs a separate bounded story.mjs correction.

The frozen design names inspectDoctor(root,{runId?,storyId?,environment?}) and stdout/file behavior, but does not pin the CLI spelling or the type of environment. Choose and test one explicit contract, preferably pm doctor --environment for stdout and a separate explicit --output tmp/environment-check.md action. The library inspector must remain nonwriting.

summary: Bounded T08 preparation only; this is not a final review. Implementation map: (1) extend analyze.mjs with one exact story-before-image read override usable only after current-pm has validated a claim journal, and add the missing top-level Status line to renderAnalysisMarkdown; preserve the current live recomputation and identity model. (2) add artifact-review.mjs to bound/normalize the frozen pre-claim schema, require exact unique semantic item coverage, all PASS items, no unresolved block/major, and compute SHA256 over the canonical normalized receipt. (3) current-pm.mjs should run first-claim analysis, parse the review, and persist normalized receipt+hash in pm-exec.artifact_review in the same claim journal; tiny/small may omit the review but still need factual READY. Same-owner resume returns retained claim/counters without rerunning the unclaimed-story rule. Bind/recheck analysis identities immediately before journal publication so concurrent artifact drift cannot leave a stale receipt in the claim. (4) replace generic current journal recovery with operation-bound validation for init/approve/revoke/claim; accept the old {format:'current',writes} only when exactly one legal operation is inferable. Validate every image before writes, then apply. Claim recovery may analyze only the exact validated before-story override. Also reject approval without Integration branch and scan generated claim deltas rather than unchanged contract prose, while retaining secret checks on introduced bytes/recovery images. (5) deliver.mjs plan correct-course must preflight the selected current run/revision, publish recoverable shared revocation first, then update the run under its revision lock. Keep baseline and max counters, archive gates/review/verification, clear active pointers only; a crash between steps remains revoked and diagnostics reports reconciliation. (6) diagnostics.mjs should own inspectContinuation and inspectDoctor, consume inspectProjectState without changing its upstream next_reference, enumerate regular UUID run files with a hard count/size bound and noncreating readers, select a unique story/run or report ambiguity, and consume T05B remoteAdmissionStatus after T05B lands. Dependency direction should remain hook/pm CLI -> diagnostics -> read-only project/run/analyzer/remote readers; mutation modules must not import diagnostics. (7) context.mjs should cap stdin bytes before JSON.parse and call pure continuation with environment disabled. Environment checks report executable/config/role/instruction names and availability only, never values or arbitrary command success. Native route mapping: migration->compatibility.md, retrospective/done->recovery.md, implementation->workflow.md, with planning and other installed references mapped explicitly; next_reference stays unchanged. Acceptance tests: analyzer override exact-path only, stale/changed bound artifacts, markdown headline; artifact receipt schema/identity/item/finding matrix; scale first-claim matrix and same-owner resume; missing Integration branch and unchanged secret-shaped prose; full AC4 typed+legacy recovery matrix including before/already-after, arbitrary story creation, contract/criteria/merged mutation, mixed/two-story writes and zero mutation on failure; correct-course crash boundary proving revoke-before-run and retained counters/history; diagnostics ambiguity/stale claim/missing run-worktree-evidence/oldest retrospective/read-only byte+mtime+Git invariants; hook byte cap/symlink/FIFO/malformed/absent-hook behavior and secret-free environment output. Update integration/reporting/current-roundtrip/correction/remote lifecycle fixtures with real scale artifacts and semantic receipts, preserving their existing assertions and awaiting accepted T05B APIs.
